title: Local boron hybrid label
statement:
Which hybrid label describes the central boron in BF₃ using the introductory valence bond model?

[_]{a}

explanations: Two hybrid orbitals cannot supply three directions.
This is the five-domain course label.

hints: Three hybrids combine s with two p orbitals.
solution: BF₃ is trigonal planar. Count three central bonding domains. Three hybrids combine s with two p orbitals. Three equivalent directions are available.
